scope: Local generalized STR prototype and two shared production refiner corrections; no public nearest routing, commit or push.
measurement_policy: Each generalized/complexity case has one first then one fresh-input warm trial. Reused query table uses the latter; not multi-trial medians. Same WKB ingress, completed builds, first/reused host outputs and synchronization. Imports, fixture generation, file/oracle work excluded. E19/E21 CPU baselines reused by validated fixture/runtime/oracle identity; previous GPU results retained.
design: Shared geometry-independent 8-way recursive STR construction; one envelope per logical feature; Morton query order; bounded resumable candidate tiles; six canonical-family device refiners; FP64 metric plan and conservative outward FP32 boxes; min/count/scatter yields NativeRelation with exact-distance ties. Fused MA segment specialization shares construction.
limits: Not integrated with public sindex or production NativeSpatialIndex cache/invalidation.
Simple synthetic fixtures do not establish complex-polygon performance: 512-edge canary loses to Shapely by 4.25x.
GeometryCollection, scalar/max_distance/exclusive contracts, component views and parent deduplication remain open.
FP64 metric-error pruning guard is not proven for arbitrary extreme coordinates. Bounds skip nonfinite envelopes.
Default 65536 query rows/batch, 8 candidate slots, 128 DFS entries; fewer than 2**24 rows per side. Dense all-tie output is output-sized. Index-byte records exclude inputs/scratch/output.
Full initcheck fails in libcudf nullable Arrow ingestion; separately isolated tree/refiner check passes.

production_changes.intersection_zero: Classify segment contact with shared adaptive orient2d before existing disjoint-distance arithmetic. Fixes positive residuals dropping exact zero ties. No tolerance collapse.
production_changes.family_launch_capacity: Divide candidate launch capacity by family pairs present in inputs rather than all 36 schema pairs; retain full-domain partition storage and device logical counts.

import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/"scripts"))
import numpy as np,shapely
from benchmark_osm_nearest import canonical,compare,write_json,sha
from experiment_nearest_hierarchy import timed
from experiment_nearest_strategies import experiment_environment
from experiment_generalized_strtree import GeneralizedSTRtree
import vibespatial as vs
vs.set_execution_mode("gpu")
root=Path("/tmp/vibespatial-osm/nearest-experiments")
report={"environment":experiment_environment(),"status":"running","measurement":"One first then one fresh-input warm trial per backend. Identical WKB ingress; host outputs and GPU synchronization included. Shared fixture work excluded.","cases":{}}
report["source_sha256"]={str(p):sha(p) for p in [Path(__file__),*Path("scripts").glob("*strtree*.py"),Path("src/vibespatial/spatial/segment_distance_kernels.py")]}
for vertices,rows in [(16,10000),(64,10000),(256,1000)]:
 rng=np.random.default_rng(1702)
 def fixture():
  centres=rng.uniform(-10000,10000,(rows,2))
  angle=np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,vertices,endpoint=False)
  xy=centres[:,None,:]+np.stack((np.cos(angle),np.sin(angle)),axis=1)[None,:,:]*4.
  holes=centres[:,None,:]+np.stack((np.cos(angle[::-1]),np.sin(angle[::-1])),axis=1)[None,:,:]*1.
  rings=shapely.linearrings(xy);inner=shapely.linearrings(holes)
  return shapely.to_wkb(shapely.polygons(rings,holes=inner[:,None]))
 twkb,qwkb=fixture(),fixture()
 key=f"{rows}-rows-{vertices}-vertices-per-ring"
 case={"rows":rows,"shell_vertices":vertices,"hole_vertices":vertices,"fixture_sha256":hashlib.sha256(b"".join(twkb)+b"".join(qwkb)).hexdigest(),"backends":{}}
 report["cases"][key]=case
 expected=None
 for backend in ("shapely","gpu"):
  gpu=backend=="gpu";constructor=vs.GeoSeries.from_wkb if gpu else shapely.from_wkb
  trials=[];case["backends"][backend]=trials
  for _ in range(2):
   record={};trials.append(record);case["active_stage"]=backend+" ingress";write_json(root/"e21-complexity.json",report)
   (t,q),record["ingress_s"]=timed(lambda:(constructor(twkb),constructor(qwkb)),gpu=gpu)
   index,record["build_s"]=timed(lambda:GeneralizedSTRtree(t) if gpu else shapely.STRtree(t),gpu=gpu)
   for stage in ("first_query_s","warm_query_s"):
    case["active_stage"]=backend+" "+stage;write_json(root/"e21-complexity.json",report)
    result,record[stage]=timed(lambda:index.query_nearest(q,all_matches=True,return_distance=True),gpu=gpu)
    if expected is None:
     expected=canonical(*result)
     op=root/("e21-oracle-"+key+".npz")
     np.savez(op,indices=expected[0],distances=expected[1]);case["oracle_sha256"]=sha(op);case["oracle_path"]=str(op)
    record[stage+"_parity"]=compare(result,expected)
    assert record[stage+"_parity"]["passed"],record[stage+"_parity"]
   if gpu:record["work"]=index.last_work
   write_json(root/"e21-complexity.json",report)
  print(key,backend,trials[-1],flush=True)
 case.pop("active_stage")
report["status"]="passed";write_json(root/"e21-complexity.json",report)

    record[stage+"_parity"]=compare(result,expected)

   if gpu:record["work"]=index.last_work
